notes: «جميعا عن ابن علية» and «إسماعيل ابن علية» are one man written twice (rule 7); the fuller form is written once.
«- واللفظ ليعقوب -» is an editor gloss and is left out.
Abu Hurayra is the last link: «فقال أبو هريرة» relays the Prophet's words. Muhammad, who tells the exchange, is a bare name.
